description.zh: 待迁移的设备名称列表。最多包含100个设备名称。
description.en: The list of device names to be migrated. A maximum of 100 device names can be specified.

description.zh: 设备所属产品的ProductKey，创建产品时，物联网平台为该产品生成的唯一标识。
description.en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs. This is the unique identifier generated by IoT Platform when the product is created.

description.zh:
设备所属的源实例ID：

- 公共实例ID：iotx-oxssharez200。
    > 目前仅支持华东2（上海）地域，其实例ID为iotx-oxssharez200。

- 企业版实例ID：登录物联网平台控制台，在**实例概览**页面，单击实例名称，在**实例详情**页面的**实例基本信息**中查看**实例ID**。
description.en:
The ID of the source instance to which the device belongs.

- Public instance ID: iotx-oxssharez200.
    > Currently, only the China (Shanghai) region is supported, and Enterprise instance ID is iotx-oxssharez200.

- Enterprise Edition instance ID: Log on to the IoT Platform console. On the **Instance Overview** page, click Enterprise instance name. On the **Instance Details** page, view the **Instance ID** in the **Basic Information** section.

description.zh:
设备迁移的目标实例ID。目标实例仅支持企业版实例。

您可登录物联网平台控制台，在**实例概览**页面，单击实例名称，在**实例详情**页面的**实例基本信息**中查看**实例ID**。
description.en:
The ID of the target instance to which the device is migrated. Only Enterprise instances are supported as the target instance.

You can log on to the IoT Platform console. On the **Instance Overview** page, click the instance name. On the **Instance Details** page, view the **Instance ID** in the **Basic Information** section.

descriptions.zh:
调用该接口迁移设备所在的实例前，请您联系技术支持人员进行迁移方案评估，防止迁移后功能无法使用。

**前提条件**

- 被迁移的设备已开通视频服务功能。
    -  公共实例的设备：登录物联网平台控制台，单击**公共实例**。在左侧菜单栏，选择**视频服务** > **接入服务**。在**接入服务**页面，单击**产品管理**页签。确认待迁移设备所在产品，对应**已开通/未开通状态**列为**已开通**。
    -  企业版实例的设备：已启用视频服务。
- 设备分发任务已经完成。详细信息，请参考[CreateDeviceDistributeJob](~~199390~~)或[设备分发](~~143450~~)。
- 确保摄像头设备已配置图片生命周期。若摄像头设备未配置图片生命周期，调用该接口后，会自动设置图片生命周期为180天。详细信息，请参考[SetDevicePictureLifeCycle](~~107880~~)。

**背景信息**
- 若迁移的源实例与目标实例类型不同，迁移前请了解实例的计费方式。计费方式详细内容，请参考[计费概述](~~124250~~)。
- 迁移过程中，设备会离线，设备数量越多迁移时间越长，在此期间设备产生的数据无法保留。
descriptions.en:
Before you invoke this operation to migrate a device to a different instance, contact the helpdesk to evaluate the migration plan and prevent feature unavailability after migration.

**Before you begin**.

- The devices to be migrated have the video service feature enabled.
    -  For devices in the Enterprise instance: Log on to the IoT Platform console and click **Enterprise instance**. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Video Service** > **Access Service**. On the **Access Service** page, click the **Product Management** tab. Verify that the product containing the devices to be migrated has the **Enabled/Not Enabled** column set to **Enabled**.
    -  For devices in Enterprise Edition instances: The video service is enabled.
- The device distribution task is complete. For more information, see [CreateDeviceDistributeJob](~~199390~~) or [Device distribution](~~143450~~).
- Make sure that the camera device has a picture lifecycle configured. If the camera device does not have a picture lifecycle configured, calling this operation automatically sets the picture lifecycle to 180 days. For more information, see [SetDevicePictureLifeCycle](~~107880~~).

**Background information**
- If the source instance and the target instance type are different, understand the billable methods of the instances before migration. For more information about billable methods, see [Billing overview](~~124250~~).
- During the migration procedure, devices go offline. The more devices there are, the longer the migration takes. Data generated by devices during this period cannot be retained.
